verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege API credentials are a fair question for a payments API platform like Flutterwave, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers SDKs, JSON responses, payment products, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI. Nothing in it mentions API key scoping, restricted keys, per-permission credentials, or issuing credentials for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
